title: UW Deal Package Manifest 1.0
description: Authoritative inventory of a UW Deal Package (RFC 0018 §3). Members are content-addressed by digest; ZIP entry order and timestamps are not semantic. Mirrors UWDealPackageManifest in @uwmd/core/deal-package.ts.

members.description: Every declared member MUST exist in the archive and match its byte digest.

links.description: Typed, directed references between member ids. Types come from the canonical edge registry (RFC 0018 §5); a package MUST NOT define a parallel registry.

path.description: Relative POSIX path resolving to exactly one non-symlink entry. Absolute paths, drive letters, backslashes, and traversal components are forbidden. Deliberately not expressed as a regex here: the rule is enforced by isSafeMemberPath() and the shared safe-ZIP inspector, where it is tested against real archives. A lookahead pattern duplicating it would be a second, weaker copy.

sha256.description: Byte digest. This is the member's identity — never a reference handle.

semantic_digest.description: Present for UW documents. A member whose representation an implementation cannot canonicalize is unverifiable, not invalid.

document_profile.description: Opaque profile token. Unknown profiles MUST be preserved and MUST NOT be interpreted as a deal-underwriting document.

type.description: A canonical member-layer type (abstracts, amends, supersedes, contributes_to, guarantees, supports) or a preserved extension type.
